name: Can proper maintenance prevent floor drain clogs?

mainEntity.name: Can proper maintenance prevent floor drain clogs?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, proper maintenance can significantly reduce the likelihood of floor drain clogs. Regular flushing with hot water, avoiding pouring grease down the drain, and installing drain grates or screens to catch hair and debris are effective preventive measures. For businesses, implementing a routine cleaning schedule and training staff on proper waste disposal are crucial. As a preparation step before a professional visit, identify areas of high usage and potential clog sources, which can help technicians quickly assess and address specific needs.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, proper maintenance like regular flushing, avoiding grease, and using drain screens can prevent clogs. Identifying high-usage areas helps prepare for professional service.
